messages.author: deb3c9be98a98104
messages.subject: Unicode in GGally
parts:
My favorite trick for rendering unicode glyphs in ggplot does not work under GGally. I’d appreciate any advice.

library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
a <- c(1,3,5)
b <- c(2,4,7)
c <- c(2,3,4)
data <- data.frame(rbind(a,b,c))
colnames(data) <- c("東京","大阪","名古屋")
ggplot(data, aes(東京,大阪)) + geom_point() + theme_gray(base_family="Meiryo") ##works great, thanks Kohske!


ggpairs(data) + theme_gray(base_family="Meiryo") ##does NOT render unicode 
ggpairs(data) + ggplot2::theme_gray(base_family="Meiryo”) ##does NOT render unicode
